name: Mobile customer changes the basket quantity and removes the tester
fullName: features/tester_purchase.feature:Mobile customer changes the basket quantity and removes the tester
description:
To try a paint colour at home before buying a full tin
As a Dulux customer
I want to add a tester for a chosen shade to my basket

Editing the basket on a phone (TC-26): the + and - buttons, the - button disabled at 1, and
removing the tester, at 375 px wide. The basket is seeded through the site's own add-to-cart API.
